title: Craftland Studio PC language-library symbol catalog
purpose: Searchable extracted symbol/enum reference derived from a publicly accessible third-party repository mirror of the Free Fire Craftland Code VS Code extension.

source.license_note: The mirror's LICENSE.md is empty. This catalog contains identifiers, signatures, enum names/values and source hashes, not copied source files or proprietary binaries.
source.authority_note: Third-party mirror and older snapshot; use for discovery only. Verify every PC entry against the current official editor libraries and current official docs. Does not prove exact Craftland Mobile block parity.
